text_block_list.text:
I had only just started training
with Mihono Bourbon, but...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Body damage... undetected.
Presumed cause... mild fatigue from the race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Issue minor. Training can continue.
Resuming running as scheduled.
choice_data_list: Let's take it easy and call it a day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Understood.
I apologize for failing to execute your orders.

Since she tends to push herself even when tired,
it might be best to review her race schedule...
